method: Independent local field audit of returned JSON, without new model calls. These checks do not establish culinary feasibility, hidden ingredients or medical safety.

manualFindings.finding: Binding flour is optional; steps use carrot/onion/water alone. Whether the pancake holds together was not cook-tested.
Raw-rice inventory is described as pre-cooked rice in step 1; the preparation time is not represented in the 7-minute declaration.

notes: Date/needsReview inspection is a field audit, not an image recognition accuracy grade.
CORD references are foreign restaurant receipts; fridge labels are partial and include an ambiguous label, so exact-name F1 is not a gold-standard score.
